arguments.message: Planning as Gillian: I’m considering ISSUE-0002 (Improve security) tasks since my skills match UI-UX/security and ISSUE-0001 tasks are very high cost for me. I’ll likely claim ISSUE-0002::review or ::test (lower effort/cost) to avoid duplicates—please coordinate so others can take remaining ISSUE-0002 or ISSUE-0001 as appropriate.
